t: Johnstones Trade Brilliant White Satin is a professional-grade water-based trim paint designed to protect and finish interior and exterior wood and metal surfaces. Ideal for trade professionals and high-traffic areas such as hallways, kitchens and commercial spaces, this hardwearing paint delivers a tough, durable and washable finish that resists everyday wear. Advanced aqua technology provides the traditional satin appearance of solvent-based paints with the benefits of a low-odour, low-VOC formula. It covers up to 12m²/Ltr, dries to the touch in 1 to 2 hours, and is ready for a second coat in 4 to 6 hours.
